purpose: Hash-pinned, finalized-vintage descriptive AU/AG underlying PA/Feitian diagnostics and signals with decision-time truncation.

decision_cadence.rule: every trading date present in the declared causal roll schedule within the frozen window

aggregation.D: OHLCV/OI over the exchange trading date; timestamp is final included period end
aggregation.W: OHLCV/OI over ISO year/week of causal D bars, including the decision-time partial week
aggregation.60min: OHLCV/OI over consecutive 60-minute trading-session offsets anchored at night-session open
aggregation.15min: OHLCV/OI over consecutive 15-minute trading-session offsets anchored at night-session open

signals.bar_direction: up when close > open, down when close < open, otherwise flat
signals.body_fraction: abs(close - open) / (high - low), null for zero range
signals.close_location: (close - low) / (high - low), null for zero range
signals.prior_20_high: maximum high of the 20 aggregated bars strictly before the current bar
signals.prior_20_low: minimum low of the 20 aggregated bars strictly before the current bar
signals.prior_20_mean_range: mean high-low of the 20 aggregated bars strictly before the current bar
signals.range_over_prior_20_mean: current range / prior_20_mean_range, null when the baseline is zero
signals.breakout_20: up when close > prior_20_high, down when close < prior_20_low, otherwise none
signals.ema_5: causal close EWM with span 5 and adjust=false through the current bar
signals.ema_20: causal close EWM with span 20 and adjust=false through the current bar
signals.ema_alignment: above when ema_5 > ema_20, below when ema_5 < ema_20, otherwise equal

revision_and_observability_limitations: Finalized current-vintage data may include corrections or revisions made after a historical decision.
The files do not prove which vendor response or dataset vintage was observable at a historical decision.
Historical survivorship, deletions, and restatements are not observable without append-only acquisition lineage.
Filesystem timestamps and maximum observation timestamps are not acquisition evidence.
